title: Not by Might
old_p1: The Lord showed Zechariah a golden lampstand with seven little lamps. Lamps then burned olive oil to make light.
Two olive trees stood beside it. Their oil flowed through golden pipes to the lamps. Zechariah asked the angel, “What are these?”
The angel had a message for Zerubbabel, who was building the Lord’s house: “Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit.”
old_p2: Might and power mean being big and strong. The Lord’s Spirit is His quiet power that helps us. With His help, Zerubbabel would finish the Lord’s house!
You do not have to be big and strong. Tonight, think of a big job for tomorrow, and remember that the Lord’s Spirit will help you.
p1: An angel woke Zechariah. “What do you see?” he asked. Zechariah saw a golden lampstand with seven little lamps.
Two olive trees stood beside it. Back then, lamps burned olive oil to make light. “What are these?” Zechariah asked.
The angel gave a message for Zerubbabel, who was building the Lord’s house. “Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit,” said the Lord.
p2: Zerubbabel did not have to be big and strong. The Lord’s Spirit would help him finish the Lord’s house!
You do not have to be big and strong either. Tonight, think of a big job for tomorrow. Say a prayer, and the Lord’s Spirit will help you.
